description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Disputes between Mr. T. B. Gunaratne Vs. National Water Supply and Drainage Board, Mrs. M. I. P. Kulathilaka Vs. Employees Trust Fund Board and Mr. P. A. M. Ratnapala and five others Vs. Sri Lankan Transport Board (S & E Only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, including orders for arbitration appointments and dispute resolutions. It involves statutory instruments, legal procedures for industrial dispute settlement, and ministerial orders made under specific legislative authority. While it mentions the Minister of Labour, it does not focus on government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the exercise of legal powers under existing legislation.
